 Predictably, those games feature two NFC teams as well. First, the Minnesota Vikings and Detroit Lions game, where a Vikings win would give a *slight* boost to the Packers' odds. However, a win would also push the Vikings to 7-0 and make the Packers' pursuit of the NFC North division crown that much harder.
